name: rekisterialusta
description: Registry Platform — multi-registry public-sector case platform (Phases 0–3, 5)

comments.runtime: Node-first, Bun-compatible (D-11). No build step: native TypeScript type-stripping runs .ts directly.
comments.database: Dev/test/offline (Env 1) use the built-in node:sqlite adapter — ZERO runtime dependencies. SQL Server (Envs 2/3) uses the OPTIONAL `mssql` dependency, loaded lazily by the adapter factory only when DB_DIALECT=sqlserver. Env 1 installs with --omit=optional (or offline, no install) and never needs mssql.
comments.auth: Three run modes selected purely by env (SQLSERVER_AUTH): mode 1 = SQLite sandbox (no SQL Server); mode 2 = local SQL Server username/password (`sql`); mode 3 = Azure SQL passwordless RBAC via managed identity (`managed-identity`). Mode 3 uses tedious's built-in MSI auth bundled in `mssql` — NO new dependency (@azure/identity is intentionally not added), so Env 1 stays zero-dep.
comments.dependencies: None REQUIRED at runtime. mssql is optional (SQL Server only). TypeScript + @types are dev-only.
